programme.title: Guadalcanal Diary
programme.desc: Battle-weary Marines (Preston Foster, Lloyd Nolan, William Bendix) hit the beach and dig in on a Japanese-held Pacific island during World War II.

programme.title: Young Jesse James
programme.desc: Frank and Jesse James join forces with Belle Starr and Cole Younger to stage a series of daring robberies.

programme.title: Short MOVIES!
programme.desc: Short movies.

programme.title: The Crystal Ball
programme.desc: A beauty contestant (Paulette Goddard) fills in for a fortuneteller and changes a lawyer's (Ray Milland) future with a rich widow (Virginia Field).

programme.title: At the Circus
programme.desc: A sly lawyer (Groucho Marx) and a pair of carnies (Harpo Marx, Chico Marx) shoot a society matron out of a cannon and try to save a circus.

programme.title: The Petrified Forest
programme.desc: An intellectual (Leslie Howard) and others are held hostage by a gangster (Humphrey Bogart) at an Arizona gas station/diner.

programme.title: Let's Make It Legal
programme.desc: A woman (Claudette Colbert) divorces her husband (Macdonald Carey) of 20 years because he gambles too much.

programme.title: The War Between Men and Women
programme.desc: A Thurberesque New Yorker (Jack Lemmon) going blind acquires a wife (Barbara Harris), three children, a dog and a drinking partner (Jason Robards).

programme.title: Jumpin' Jack Flash
programme.desc: A British spy abroad taps into a New York computer operator's (Whoopi Goldberg) bank terminal and asks her for help.

programme.title: Hopscotch
programme.desc: An ex-CIA agent (Walter Matthau) and his lover (Glenda Jackson) write a book about the agency, one jump ahead of agents sent to stop them.

programme.title: Take Her, She's Mine
programme.desc: Parents (James Stewart, Audrey Meadows) let their teenage daughter (Sandra Dee) study in Paris, but the father follows to spy on her.

programme.title: Beyond the Valley of the Dolls
programme.desc: Three college singers (Dolly Read, Cynthia Myers, Marcia McBroom) join a Hollywood scene of debauchery, drugs and rock 'n' roll.

programme.title: Somebody Up There Likes Me
programme.desc: A youth turns his rebellious nature into a successful ring career in this fact-based portrait of boxer Rocky Graziano.

programme.title: The Eagle Has Landed
programme.desc: A Nazi colonel (Robert Duvall) drops a colonel (Michael Caine), a task force and an Irishman (Donald Sutherland) into England to kidnap Winston Churchill.

programme.title: The Long, Hot Summer
programme.desc: A small-town Mississippi boss tries to pair his daughter (Joanne Woodward) with an enigmatic drifter (Paul Newman).

programme.title: A Day at the Races
programme.desc: Doctor Hugo Hackenbush (Groucho Marx), Tony (Chico Marx), and Stuffy (Harpo Marx) upset a sanitorium, orchestra pit, water carnival and steeplechase.

programme.title: East Side, West Side
programme.desc: A New Yorker's (James Mason) mistress (Ava Gardner) drives his wife (Barbara Stanwyck) to a war hero; then someone kills the mistress.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: An attractive lawyer and Bridget's (Rene Zellweger) former boss (Hugh Grant) threaten her newfound happiness with Mark Darcy (Colin Firth).

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: A frustrated novelist begins to depend less on his imaginary friend when he forms a unique bond with a Long Island teenager.

programme.title: The April Fools
